subject: [hw] V41 start: AP side of the encoder (venc VCU interface) + DMA mirror
body: V41 starting. Host-only. Files: ap/{mtk_venc_ipi.h (GPL-2.0 structs/ids of venc_ipi_msg.h + vcodec_ipi_msg.h + venc_vsi with static asserts for the 32-bit daemon), n2ap_venc.{c,h}, n2vc_dma.c, MESSAGE_FLOW.md, test_v41/**}. Depends on include/n2vc_hw.h and on V40 for the vcu device model; I posted the kernel-role API I need to hw-v40 and will use a local stand-in until their header lands. IV/IP: n2ap_venc.h will be the encoder session API (open/query_cap/set_param/start/encode/close, frame+bs as DMA handles, key flag out) - tell me now if the runner wants different names or an opaque handle. K02: I need the exact power/clock steps your kernel does on RWVC_POWER(VENC) so that VCU_IPIMSG_ENC_POWER_ON -> hw->power(VENC) + clock steps is faithful; I am reading nord2_vcodec.inc for them, no action if that is the source of truth. No phone, no publish, no vendor binaries copied.
